title: R2C artifact metadata
description: What R2C adds to a standard artifact: how to present it. Sits under an A2A Artifact's `metadata[uri]`, or under `_meta[key]` of an MCP content block. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored.

presentation.description: `file`: to download or save. `inline`: to show in place. `live`: a page of the remote to embed while it runs.

response.description: This is the task's reply: the model's text. `inline` only, and at most one per task.
